assumptions.statement: Site and key-area geometry used before organizer-supplied official polygons is provisional rough geometry only.
assumptions.impact: All exact locations, areas, ratios and spatial metrics must be recomputed when official geometry becomes available.

assumptions.statement: Detailed statutory controls, ownership, heritage-control lines, road redlines, utilities, building surveys, fire and engineering conditions are not yet available as cleared project evidence.
assumptions.impact: Building locations, envelopes, retain-adapt-remove choices and infrastructure routes remain conceptual and cannot be treated as approval or construction documents.

assumptions.statement: The Civic Engineering Hall and People's AI Service Station are conceptual public anchors derived from the site's documented red, industrial and community-cultural context; their exact sites are deliberately not fixed at v0.1.
assumptions.impact: Final siting requires heritage, ownership, access, transport and engineering review; the proposal makes no claim that a specific parcel is available.

assumptions.statement: Five civic AI rights—notice, choice, refusal, human review, and appeal/correction—are proposed design and operating requirements, not a claim that these exact five categories are already enacted as a single statutory code.
assumptions.impact: They must be reconciled with applicable law, operator authority, procurement terms, privacy rules and professional governance before implementation.

assumptions.statement: The proposal translates the 2026 policy principle that AI should remain under human control into visible urban mechanisms such as human handoff, stop controls, responsibility signage, appeal and service fallback.
assumptions.impact: This is a design interpretation and does not imply official endorsement of any specific spatial or technical solution.

assumptions.statement: No AI pilot is assumed to improve service before an ordinary non-AI baseline is measured.
assumptions.impact: v0.1 defines metric directions only; it does not fabricate success rates, waiting times, error rates or public satisfaction values.

assumptions.statement: Nine user groups are treated as design acceptance groups, with special attention to people who may be excluded by smartphone, account, biometric or AI-only service requirements.
assumptions.impact: Detailed demographic weighting and sample sizes require official or field evidence before quantitative claims are made.

assumptions.statement: The sequence railway → Zhongguancun → AI is a design narrative linking engineering labor, scientific innovation and everyday public benefit; it is not presented as a complete academic history of the corridor.
assumptions.impact: Exhibition content must undergo historical-source review and distinguish documented facts from interpretive narrative.

assumptions.statement: Red brick, red ceramic, steel, timber and traceable reused railway steel are proposed visual/material directions rather than confirmed construction materials.
assumptions.impact: Fire, durability, embodied-carbon, heritage, structural, maintenance and procurement suitability must be verified before design development.

assumptions.statement: The twelve AI scenarios and three flagship validation protocols are v0.1 programme hypotheses.
assumptions.impact: Each must later receive explicit operator, data source, privacy boundary, non-AI baseline, human fallback, stop condition and measurable validation criteria.
